channel.title: Release on IoTone, Inc.
channel.description: Recent content in Release on IoTone, Inc.

item.title: Burisu — KPT Bryce, reborn in the browser on WebGPU
item.description: IoTone opened Burisu (ブライス), a browser-native remake of the classic KPT Bryce 3D landscape generator — Rust to WASM, rendered with WebGPU, and gated on running well on a 4GB Raspberry Pi 5.

item.title: MusicPixels — a generative synth on the M5 Cardputer ADV + Unit Glass
item.description: CardputerADV Hacking Japan opens with MusicPixels: a self-contained generative synthesizer for the M5Stack Cardputer ADV, with audio-reactive geometry on a transparent M5 Unit Glass OLED.

item.title: NekoChan — a fully-offline Japanese cat lens for Spectacles
item.description: Spectacles-NekoChan is a Snap Spectacles lens where a 3D cat shares facts — in Japanese — about native breeds and Japan’s cat islands, running entirely on-device with no internet and no experimental APIs.

item.title: BowleraramaXR — a Godot XR bowling starter for Quest 3 and Android XR
item.description: A synthwave-themed bowling alley doubling as a working Godot XR starter for Android XR and Meta Quest 3 — packaging the build-and-deploy steps the official docs skip.

item.title: gsplats-to-webxr — a starter for Gaussian splats in a headset
item.description: A minimal starter that gets Gaussian splats into WebXR — Spark rendering 3DGS over Three.js, served over HTTPS so it drops straight into a headset.

item.title: MIDI Bleep Blop — perform on live synths from a Spectacles lens
item.description: A MIDI library and bridge so you can perform on live musical instruments from a Snap Spectacles lens — now with a Tester Lens you can try yourself. An IoTone, Inc. #Lensfest May 2026 OSS drop.

item.title: Spectacles SkywriterBLE — typing in AR
item.description: A BLE HID keyboard reference for Snap Spectacles, with a prototype word processor on top. Solves typing in AR.

item.title: Three new IoTone Japan landing pages: RobotARme, Moire Lens Lab, No Foosball No Life
item.description: Sites go live for the RobotARme platform, the Moire Lens Lab art book, and the No Foosball No Life community.

item.title: Polynode launches: the missing web libraries for Snap Spectacles
item.description: Spectacles-polynode ships first cut: SpaceCanvas, SpaceSVG, SpaceDOM, EventEmitter — backfills HTML5 platform APIs that Lens Studio doesn’t ship.

item.title: MatriXR90sVibe — a Matrix XR client with 90s vibes
item.description: An augmented-reality reading of the Matrix protocol, with a 90s aesthetic.

item.title: Z-Machine port to Snap Spectacles XR
item.description: tszm ported to Spectacles, with a reference design for Spatial IF — interactive fiction in AR.

item.title: Dr. Medaka's School of Fish & Kanji Learners — landing page
item.description: Static content site for Dr. Medaka, an IoTone Japan client project.

item.title: SharpFlow: drag-and-drop ML pipeline (no Python required)
item.description: A simple app pipeline for using ML.NET (Sharp) in a drag-and-drop splat pipeline, for people who don’t need Python in their lives.

item.title: Spectacles WebSocket Playground
item.description: A small playground for testing WebSockets in the Spectacles environment.

item.title: Matrix WebSocket Bridge AR/XR adapter
item.description: An AR/XR UI wrapper around the Matrix WebSocket bridge.

item.title: cl-abcl-gradle-bootstrap: Common Lisp on the JVM the easy way
item.description: A Gradle-based bootstrap for ABCL, simplifying devops for Common Lisp apps on the JVM.

item.title: Spectacles-Matematex: LaTex math notation in AR
item.description: Matematex is a LaTex parser and renderer for Snap Spectacles, for rendering math notation in AR.

item.title: offlinesns: bringing Meshtastic to Japan, starting in Fukuoka
item.description: Community initiative to bring Meshtastic to Japan, starting in Fukuoka.

item.title: libMQTTSpecs — MQTT for Snap Spectacles
item.description: An MQTT library (TypeScript port from JS) for Snap Spectacles.

item.title: Awesome Spatial Design
item.description: A curated list of spatial-design tools, talks, processes, themes, idea boards, and sample apps.

item.title: HelloSDL3: SDL3 starter for Xcode, iOS, and visionOS
item.description: An SDL3 starter scaffold for Xcode / iOS / visionOS projects.

item.title: SpectaclesDeskWindow ships — first OSS spatial desktop mirror
item.description: Spatial desktop mirroring solution for Snap Spectacles AR glasses — the first OSS solution for streaming a desktop into AR.

item.title: omnitone-demo-aframe: spatial audio in A-Frame
item.description: An A-Frame demo using Omnitone for spatial audio in WebXR.

item.title: SnapSpectaclesIKSamples — Interaction Kit starter samples
item.description: Snap Spectacles Interaction Kit Samples designed as a building block for new lenses.

item.title: Flutter Responsive Mobile App Starter (IoTone Japan)
item.description: Boilerplate for app-store-ready Flutter mobile apps; used by IoTone Japan as a client training tool.

item.title: hugo-gwatt-japan-biz-theme + Awesome Design Thinking EN/JA
item.description: A bilingual JA/EN business Hugo theme, plus a curated reading list on design thinking.

item.title: RockeTone — IoT-instrumented papercraft and model rockets
item.description: IoTone Japan’s RockeTone modernizes papercraft and model rockets with IoT hardware and software.

item.title: OpenWR — open hardware for wearable IoT
item.description: An open-hardware reference platform for wearable IoT.

item.title: Shashin Go open-source DIY camera, demoed at CES 2024
item.description: Shashin Go Concept 1 + 2 — open-source hardware design for an AI-data-capture wearable camera. Demoed at CES 2024.

item.title: Project MAG*Net launches: distributed IoT data sync for Matter / Zigbee / Thread
item.description: Project MAG*Net is an IoT data sync and control app, plus a distributed server for IoT data, across Matter, Zigbee, Thread, HomeKit, BLE, and Wi-Fi.

item.title: M5Stacks Atom Echo Looper — Eurorack-compatible looper
item.description: A Eurorack-compatible audio looper based on the M5 Stacks Atom Echo board.

item.title: NFTYGlobe: NFC-based 3D NFT viewer for OpenSea
item.description: An NFC-based 3D NFT viewer for OpenSea — hardware + software prototype.

item.title: libkeccak-d: SHA-3 / Keccak for Dlang
item.description: A simple SHA-3 / Keccak hash function for Dlang, wrapping the keccak-tiny C implementation.
